purpose: Read-only upstream source-impact group proposal; no native/runtime support or source-profile admission follows from a path match.

groups.reason: Out-of-line sh_node_type_base/common_node_type_base poll, default texture coordinates and texture mapping helpers.
Registration helper defines which tree contexts accept a FunctionNode; node class availability alone is insufficient.
notes: fn_cmp_node_type_base is present in the measured53 source, not inferred for older revisions. Actual context creation still needs native probes.

groups.reason: GPU_stack_link/GPU_link resolve shader function symbols through out-of-line library lookup and code generation.
notes: There is no gpu_material_library.cc in the measured53 tree; its function implementations are in gpu_shader_dependency.cc.

groups.reason: Inlining chooses primitive constant evaluation using a node MF callback when all consumed inputs are primitive.
notes: These files are absent42; that is known version structure, not unresolved proof.
Squeeze has no own MF evaluator; input folding may affect its graph, but do not declare a Squeeze MF profile.

groups.reason: Pixel-unit routing selects native CPU MF for all-single-value units even when compositor device is GPU; shader and typed procedure code are out-of-line.
notes: 52 routing is node_group_operation.cc;53 is node_tree_evaluator.cc. Do not copy a53 path into a52 manifest.
No modern42 MF compositor route is claimed by this group. FloatToInt has no compositor creation in42/52.

groups.reason: Legacy realtime compositor evaluation/compile/shader routing differs from modern pixel-unit dispatch.
notes: A source-impact group only, not evidence that a particular legacy CPU or GPU operation is supported.

groups.reason: Header-only include discovery misses the out-of-line implicit type-conversion registry implementation.
BLI_radial_tiling.hh declares the algorithm; the actual MF implementation is wrapper.cc including the CPU shared header.
notes: A dependency of native MF research/source models, not admission of MF to the shader-only Radial proposal. GPU shared header must also be watched independently.

groups.reason: Image-bearing slices also depend on native mapping/filter/color handling, actual image GPU upload and the measured source backend texture path.
notes: Conditional on an image-bearing source slice. Filter backend-specific impact by measured native profile; listing a backend path does not qualify that backend.

groups.reason: BSL/material compatibility declarations moved paths; resolve at each revision rather than assuming one filename.
notes: This group has no compat.hh file in42; legacy GLSL uses its own include closure.

legacyRnaMapping.nativeIdRule: concatenate macro arguments1and5 after parsing balanced macro arguments
legacyRnaMapping.legacyTypeRule: argument2; preserve family/registration-context because expressions can overlap across Shader/Texture domains

limits: Quoted include/pragma closure and GPU literal-symbol discovery remain necessary; these groups address known non-include edges only.
Retain unresolved symbol/path changes for review; do not infer a closed graph when resolution is incomplete.
New binary/compiler/backend profile still requires native qualification even with unchanged source/RNA hashes.
Group paths are coarse review triggers, not a proof that every change modifies numerical semantics.
